skill_name: Explain the difference between a nuclear and a solar powered plant.
workflow: The primary difference between a nuclear powered plant and a solar powered plant is the source of energy used to generate electricity. A nuclear power plant utilizes an atomic reactor as an energy source to generate electrical power, while a solar power plant utilizes solar panels to capture the sun's energy and convert it into usable electricity.
